messages:
marta.sales: Heads-up  Zenith procurement sent an orderform redline asking for a 20% payment escrow until onboarding complete, and they want a delegated procurement signatory (they call it 'Agency Signer') to execute the PO. Attached their redline: https://zenith.example/zenith-po-redline.pdf
marta.sales: They also changed payment terms to Net60 and added a clause requiring a monthly audit window for "data processing logs" for 90 days post-PO.
jin.finance: Net60+20% escrow is rough on cashflow. Suggest counter: Net30 with 10% escrow or milestone holdback tied to test acceptance. We need revenue recognition input if escrow is third-party controlled.
will.legal: On delegated signer: acceptable if we get a delegation letter signed by an MSA signatory. We should not add new signatory rows to the MSA. Proposed clause: "Execution by an Authorized Procurement Representative shall be valid only if accompanied by a Delegation of Authority executed by a Contract Signatory identified in the MSA."
will.legal: On escrow: we must define who controls release. If Zenith wants unilateral release on 'onboarding complete' that's too vague. Define objective acceptance criteria in Exhibit B and splits for partial completion.
rachel.eng: For onboarding criteria, propose tests: successful model inference on sample corpus (latency < 300ms p95), integration test passing with sample keys, and verified network allowlist. Dedicated capacity spin-up time depends on region; estimate 7-12 business days.
sec-bot: Reminder: Security review required for any log retention >30 days in EU regions. See: /security/policies/log-retention.md
marta.sales: Zenith is also asking to add HSM/KMS keystore requirements into the DPA. That may trigger Private deployment discussion.
will.legal: KMS/HSM asks usually escalate. For POC we can accept a transitional approach: customer-managed keys for production, Redwood-managed pseudonymized telemetry for POC. Add explicit scope to the DPA Annex: "POC telemetry limited to pseudonymized logs; KMS/HSM requirements apply only to production deployments."
jin.finance: If they insist on escrow account, propose milestone schedule instead: 40% on signature, 40% on POC acceptance, 20% after 30-day stability. That avoids third-party escrow overhead.
marta.sales: I'm going to propose Net30 + milestone split and require delegation letter if they want agency signer. Also push back on monthly audit access; propose quarterly read-only logs with narrow scope.
rachel.eng: I'll draft Exhibit B onboarding tests and timeline (will include expected infra spin-up times and required sample datasets). Can have a draft by EOD.
will.legal: I'll prepare a tracked-change redline to the order form and DPA. Will add Delegation of Authority appendix template.
marta.sales: Great. If they reply wanting DocuSign by the Agency Signer, clarify we accept DocuSign but need the delegation doc attached as a signer evidence item.
doc-bot: Attached templates: /assets/templates/delegation-of-authority-template.pdf, /assets/templates/onboarding-exhibit-template.md
jin.finance: FYI I'll run the milestone split through revenue team and confirm any ASC/IFRS implications. Ping me if they insist on escrow bank details.
marta.sales: I'll send the counter today. Marking as high priority  Zenith POC kickoff depends on this. Tagging @will.legal @jin.finance @rachel.eng for follow-ups.
